name: Stone Stack
description: Smooth river stones balanced three high, each stone a different soft shape that shifts when the pile is reset.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { width: 54%; height: 21%; top: 6%; border-radius: @r(38, 62)% @r(38, 62)% @r(38, 62)% @r(38, 62)% / @r(38, 62)% @r(38, 62)% @r(38, 62)% @r(38, 62)%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@r(-6, 6)deg); transform: rotate(@r(-6, 6)deg); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -32%; top: 98%; width: 164%; height: 132%; border-radius: @r(36, 64)% @r(36, 64)% @r(36, 64)% @r(36, 64)% / @r(36, 64)% @r(36, 64)% @r(36, 64)% @r(36, 64)%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@r(-4, 4)deg); transform: rotate(@r(-4, 4)deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 16%; bottom: 97%; width: 68%; height: 104%; border-radius: @r(36, 64)% @r(36, 64)% @r(36, 64)% @r(36, 64)% / @r(36, 64)% @r(36, 64)% @r(36, 64)% @r(36, 64)%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@r(-8, 8)deg); transform: rotate(@r(-8, 8)deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
